# Understand AI. Build AI.

An open-source, community-maintained A–Z reference to the concepts, tools,
algorithms, architectures, and systems used in modern AI engineering.

::: {.callout-note}
**Our approach:** Every topic starts with an accessible explanation, then
builds toward technical depth, practical examples, and further reading.
:::

## Explore the dictionary

Browse concepts alphabetically, from foundational artificial intelligence
to production inference systems, autonomous agents, robotics, and beyond.

[Explore the A–Z dictionary](/dictionary/index.html)

## Learn by doing

Selected entries are accompanied by Jupyter notebooks containing runnable
examples, experiments, visualizations, and mathematical demonstrations.

[Explore notebooks](/notebooks/index.html)

## Built by the community
AI Engineer Dictionary is being actively developed by [Ebube Akukwe](https://www.linkedin.com/in/ebube-akukwe-3690a3336/)
Anyone can suggest a term, improve an explanation, add a reference, or
contribute a notebook.

[Read the contribution guide](contribute.qmd)

## Project principles

- **Accuracy:** Prefer authoritative sources and technically precise explanations.
- **Clarity:** Explain the idea simply before introducing specialist terminology.
- **Depth:** Include mathematics, code, and implementation details when useful.
- **Reproducibility:** Notebooks should be runnable and explain their dependencies.
- **Openness:** Contributions are reviewed in public through GitHub pull requests.

This Project is built entirely with [Quarto](https://quarto.org/docs/get-started/) and [Jupyter Notebooks](https://docs.jupyter.org/)
